name: Workspace Names
author: Fred Nix & Larry
description: Give Hyprland workspaces a title without touching the numbers in the bar. The focused workspace's name always sits right after the numbers (click it to rename); hover a number for its name; a small pill slides in on switch. Names live in ~/.config/omarchy/workspace-names.json.

barWidget.description: The stock workspace numbers, plus the focused workspace's name pinned right after them (click to rename), hover a number to see its name, and an inline editor. Replaces omarchy.workspaces in the bar layout.
